cd /tmp/r2run-ng29sfbf/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/a.py <<'E'
import re,glob,sys
U=["centerpoint","northern indiana public service","nipso","citizens gas","citizens energy","vectren","indiana american water","ohio valley gas","american electric power","duke energy","community natural gas","midwest natural gas","frontier communications"]
U[2]="nipsco"
c={}
n=0
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    t=open(f).read()
    pages=re.split(r'=== page \d+\n',t)[1:]
    for p in pages:
        if 'Respondent:' not in p: continue
        n+=1
        m=re.search(r'Respondent:(.*?)\n\s*Other Party',p,re.S)
        r=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',m.group(1)).strip().lower() if m else ''
        if not m: print('NORESP',f)
        u=r.startswith(tuple(U))
        m2=re.search(r'civil penalty:(.*?)Abstentions',p,re.S|re.I)
        if not m2: print('NOREC',f); continue
        rec=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',m2.group(1)).lower()
        add=re.search(r'Additional Information:(.*?)APPROVED',p,re.S)
        a=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',add.group(1)).lower() if add else ''
        w='warning letter' in rec
        if not w and 'warning' in rec: print('near',f,rec)
        if 'warning letter' in a and not w: c.setdefault('addonly',0); c['addonly']+=1
        k=u; c.setdefault((k,'n'),0);c[(k,'n')]+=1
        if w: c.setdefault((k,'w'),0);c[(k,'w')]+=1
print(n,c)
for k in (True,False): print(k,100*c.get((k,'w'),0)/c[(k,'n')])
E
python3 -I $TMPDIR/a.py; grep -c "Respondent:" *.txt | awk -F: '{s+=$2}END{print s}'; ls ../text | grep -E "NPT|\.04"; grep -il "warning" *.txt | wc -l
